# GUMGO

> Electronic music producer, DJ and vinyl curator based in Barcelona. Dub
> techno, electro and minimal, played on vinyl and built on bass and
> percussion. Real name Jessica Eunjung Lee. Debut EP due 2027.

This is a press kit. Everything on it is meant to be read, quoted and passed
on, by people and by assistants alike. There is one page; it is short, it is
readable without JavaScript, and the biography is offered at three lengths in
four languages for anyone who needs to paste one into a listing.

## Page

- [Press kit](https://gumgo.xyz/): sets, statement, rooms played, biography
  and contact, in that order.

## Facts

- Working name: GUMGO. Legal name: Jessica Eunjung Lee.
- Based in Barcelona. Debuted in Singapore, 2024.
- Plays dub techno, electro, minimal and acid, on vinyl.
- Trained on the janggu, Korean percussion, from age nine.
- Rooms include HÖR Berlin, Studio Stereo Barcelona, Ganok Lviv,
  Headquarters Singapore, Bar Temp Bangkok, Faust Seoul, Output Busan.
- Radio and mixes: 20ft Radio Kyiv, Oslated Special Mix 097, Seoul Community
  Radio, Aaja Music London, Headstream Bali, Shutter Rhythms, TOHA Radio.
- Featured in Mixmag Asia, Artists Exciting Us, 2026.
- Debut EP finished, due 2027.
